story.text: 막차가 끊긴 시간이었다. 하늘이 도로변에 서서 손을 들었다. '택시 잡자.'
story.reading: mak-cha-ga kkeun-kin si-gan-i-eot-da. ha-neul-i do-ro-byeon-e seo-seo son-eul deul-eot-da. 'taek-si jap-ja.'
story.en: It was past the last bus. Haneul stood at the roadside and raised his hand. "Let's grab a taxi."

story.text: 택시가 서자 그가 먼저 문을 열어줬다. 기사님께 목적지를 또박또박 말하는 것도 그의 몫이었다.
story.reading: taek-si-ga seo-ja geu-ga meon-jeo mun-eul yeol-eo-jwot-da. gi-sa-nim-kke mok-jeok-ji-reul tto-bak-tto-bak mal-ha-neun geot-do geu-ui mog-i-eot-da.
story.en: When the taxi stopped, he opened the door for me first. Telling the driver our destination clearly was his job too.

story.text: '주소 정확히 아세요?' 기사님이 묻자, 하늘은 휴대폰 지도를 내밀며 위치를 짚어줬다.
story.reading: 'ju-so jeong-hwak-hi a-se-yo?' gi-sa-nim-i mud-ja, ha-neul-eun hyu-dae-pon ji-do-reul nae-mil-myeo wi-chi-reul jip-eo-jwot-da.
story.en: "Do you know the exact address?" the driver asked. Haneul held out his phone map and pointed to the location.

story.text: '이 길로 가면 더 빠를 텐데.' 그가 창밖을 보며 중얼거렸다. 기사님도 고개를 끄덕이며 방향을 틀었다.
story.reading: 'i gil-lo ga-myeon deo ppa-reul ten-de.' geu-ga chang-bakk-eul bo-myeo jung-eol-geo-ryeot-da. gi-sa-nim-do go-gae-reul kkeu-deok-i-myeo bang-hyang-eul teul-eot-da.
story.en: "Going this way would be faster." He murmured, looking out the window. The driver nodded and changed direction.

story.text: 도착하자 요금이 화면에 떴다. 내가 지갑을 꺼내기도 전에, 하늘이 이미 카드를 내밀고 있었다.
story.reading: do-chak-ha-ja yo-geum-i hwa-myeon-e tteot-da. nae-ga ji-gab-eul kkae-nae-gi-do jeon-e, ha-neul-i i-mi ka-deu-reul nae-mil-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: When we arrived, the fare popped up on the screen. Before I could even get my wallet out, Haneul had already held out his card.

story.text: '다음엔 나도 낼게.' 내가 투덜대자, 그는 대꾸도 없이 차 문을 열어줬다. 늘 그런 식이었다.
story.reading: 'da-eum-en na-do nael-ge.' nae-ga tu-deol-dae-ja, geu-neun dae-kkoe-do eop-si cha mun-eul yeol-eo-jwot-da. neul geu-reon sig-i-eot-da.
story.en: "I'll pay next time." I grumbled, but he just opened the car door without a word. It was always like that.

story.text: 밤길을 걸어 집 앞까지 데려다주며 그가 말했다. '잘 들어가.' 짧은 인사였지만, 이상하게 마음이 놓였다.
story.reading: bam-gil-eul geol-eo jib ap-kka-ji de-ryeo-da-ju-myeo geu-ga mal-haet-da. 'jal deul-eo-ga.' jjalb-eun in-sa-yeot-ji-man, i-sang-ha-ge ma-eum-i noh-yeot-da.
story.en: Walking me the rest of the way home along the night road, he said, "Get in safe." It was a short goodbye, but strangely, it put my mind at ease.

words.example_en: Please call a taxi for me.
Please take me to this address.
How much did the fare come to?

sentences.en: Please take me to this address.
